caption:
Pick one calculator for the SAT, and practice with only that one.

Desmos is built into Bluebook, or you can bring an acceptable calculator. Either works on the whole Math section. Switching between them is what slows you down.

Comment which one you use.
tiktok_caption: Pick one SAT calculator and master it. Desmos or your own, not both.

youtube.title: SAT Tip: Pick One Calculator and Master It
youtube.description: You can use Bluebook's built-in Desmos or an acceptable calculator on the whole SAT Math section. Pick one and practice with it every time.
